description: Source code implementing cache maintenance operations for Cortex-A/R AArch32 cores, including functions for enabling, disabling, flushing, and invalidating data and instruction caches, with support for D-cache and I-cache configurations.

methods.name: arch_dcache_line_size_get
methods.description: Returns the smallest data cache line size by reading the system register and calculating the size.

methods.name: arch_dcache_enable
methods.description: Enables data cache by invalidating all, setting control register bits, and issuing memory barriers.

methods.name: arch_dcache_disable
methods.description: Disables data cache by clearing control register bits and flushing/invalidation.

methods.name: arch_dcache_flush_and_invd_all
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates entire data cache.

methods.name: arch_dcache_flush_range
methods.description: Flushes data cache over a specified memory range.

methods.name: arch_dcache_invd_range
methods.description: Invalidates data cache over a specified memory range.

methods.name: arch_dcache_flush_and_invd_range
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates data cache over a specified memory range.

methods.name: arch_icache_enable
methods.description: Enables instruction cache by invalidating all and setting control register bits.

methods.name: arch_icache_disable
methods.description: Disables instruction cache by clearing control register bits.

methods.name: arch_icache_flush_and_invd_all
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates instruction cache (not supported, returns -ENOTSUP).

methods.name: arch_icache_flush_range
methods.description: Flushes instruction cache over a range (not supported, returns -ENOTSUP).

methods.name: arch_icache_invd_range
methods.description: Invalidates instruction cache over a range (not supported, returns -ENOTSUP).

methods.name: arch_icache_flush_and_invd_range
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates instruction cache over a range (not supported, returns -ENOTSUP).
